title: Enterprise Connectivity: measured-volume decimal places
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following measured-volume decimal places for each named contract tier. Meter quantity decimal places; integer.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | measured-volume decimal places | 6 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | measured-volume decimal places | 6 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | measured-volume decimal places | 6 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | measured-volume decimal places | 6 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | measured-volume decimal places | 6 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | measured-volume decimal places | 6 |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the measured-volume decimal places is 6.
